summary: Elva provides payment controls for Coral Pay's contractor payout launch, with NUSD recipient-wallet screening for Solana payouts, hosted on Microsoft Azure in Australia East.
deliverables: Production environment on Microsoft Azure, Australia East
Payout ledger connector, up to 12,000 payouts a day at launch
Sanctions screening, up to 25,000 names a day
Payout exceptions in the case management workspace
NUSD wallet screening for Solana payouts
